description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Wyoming Statutes (W.S.) — Wyoming state law — by citation. "6-2-101" is murder in the first degree (Title 6, Crimes and Offenses); "20-1-105" is divorce grounds (Title 20). Accepts natural forms: "6-2-101", "W.S. 6-2-101", "§ 6-2-101". Returns the current statutory text, the section heading, and — where the source carries one cleanly — an enactment/amendment "history" note; many sections have no such note (Wyoming does not uniformly separate amendment history from body text). Wyoming publishes the CURRENT edition only; no historical/prior-year version is available online. Title 97 (the Constitution) is not covered — it uses "Article N, Section N" citations, a different scheme. Keyless. Use for "what does W.S. 6-2-101 say" or to check a Wyoming statute a case or contract relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "6-2-101" (murder) or "20-1-105" (divorce grounds). Title-chapter-section, dash separated; a few titles carry a decimal (e.g. "34.1-1-101", Uniform Commercial Code).
